comment: HAND-COMPUTED synthetic golden world for A14-V14-A5-BASISLV-PREMFADE (V14 I lane i-family-1). 13 symbols carry a CONSTANT per-bucket basis-route premium p_b = c_i on every 15m bucket (availability = bucket close, honest); therefore b_i(T) = mean(p_b) = c_i EXACTLY at any formation length, for both the 2688-bucket (28d) anchor and the 5376-bucket (56d) neighbour. Every expected value below is derived BY HAND from the frozen book rule (ranks ascend by (b_i, symbol id); long = k lowest, short = k highest, k = floor(n_eligible/3); equal weight 1/(2k); middle flat; gross 1.0) and must be reproduced exactly by the machinery. Synthetic book facts only: no real data, no scored outcome of any kind.

hand_computed.b_i_equals_constant: b_i(T) = c_i exactly (mean of a constant series), anchor and neighbour alike

anchor.hand_note: k = floor(13/3) = 4; the 4 lowest premiums are the deep discounts (SYM00..SYM03, -6e-4..-3e-4), the 4 highest the rich premia (SYM09..SYM12, +3e-4..+6e-4); per leg 1/(2*4) = 1/8 = 0.125 <= 0.30

neighbour.hand_note: constant premium levels rank identically under the 5376-bucket (56d) formation; the neighbour book is EXACTLY the anchor book on this world

control_inv.hand_note: the causal negative control is the EXACT sign-inverted anchor book: every weight element-wise negated, legs swapped end-to-end

tie_scenario.hand_note: premiums SYM08 = SYM09 = +2e-4 tie EXACTLY at the short-tier boundary; the declared (b_i, symbol id ascending) ordering sends the lexicographically LARGER symbol (SYM09) short and keeps SYM08 in the middle tercile

refusal_scenario.hand_note: one missing slot (NaN premium bucket) in SYM02's anchor formation window REFUSES SYM02 at the stamp (fail-closed, L-V12-5): n_eligible drops 13 -> 12, k stays 4, and SYM04 (the next-lowest premium) is promoted into the long leg

below_floor_scenario.hand_note: two refused symbols leave 11 eligible names < the frozen 12-name floor: the stamp REFUSES with EligibilityShortfall (no book, fail-closed)

availability_mutation.hand_note: stamping ONE window bucket of a symbol available after the decision (available = T + 15m) makes the row unreadable at T: the symbol refuses with UNAVAILABLE_ROW (a decision at T can never read available_time > T)
